PR12 is nepsis: catching a movement of the heart before it hardens into action. This passage describes trained deceit — they have taught their tongue to speak lies — with ambush laid deliberately while the mouth speaks peace. That is a plan being executed, not a lapse in guarding. A practice's absence and a different failure entirely are not the same anchor.
